guide.tetanusmod.salvage.body:
Dropped metal rusts after five consecutive seconds touching water, including floating at its surface, or 15 seconds exposed to rain. A roof protects against rain. Names, enchantments and durability survive conversion.

Five iron tools have rusted variants: sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe. Rusted tools have a 20 percent infection chance on melee hits.

Dropped fishing rods break after five seconds in water: two sticks, two string, and a 15 percent chance of a Rusty Fishing Hook.

A hookline reaches 12 blocks, pulls and infects a target, and has durability plus a two-second cooldown. Solid blocks obstruct it.

Mutant salvage: Rust plus iron nuggets, copper, flint, string, coal or bone.

A grindstone removes rust and ordinary enchantments. A brush preserves enchantments.

guide.tetanusmod.diseases.body:
Tetanus: random %s-%s seconds per infection. Symptoms develop into muscle stiffness, involuntary spasms and movement disturbances.

Lockjaw Sonata blocks eating continuously during the final random 2-4 minutes. Drinking remains possible. Milk cannot cure Tetanus or Lockjaw. Drink Tetanus Antitoxin, or wait for natural recovery.

Salmonella: raw infected meat has a 10%% chance. Vomiting every 10 seconds causes nausea, hunger loss and mild nonlethal damage. Cook infected meat first.

Strange Meat: pick up infected meat. Why did I eat that?: contract Salmonella. Eating without Salmonella does not award it.

guide.tetanusmod.crafting.body:
Wire Brush: three iron nuggets across top, copper ingot center, stick below. Hold rusty equipment in the opposite hand and use the brush. Cleaning returns one Rust per action and charges durability per cleaned item.

Antitoxin: honey bottle, golden carrot, fermented spider eye across top; glass bottle below the carrot. Drink to cure Tetanus and Lockjaw. Returns a bottle.

Field Guide: book + Rust + feather, shapeless.

Rusty Hookline: rusty fishing hook + chain + string + stick, shapeless.

Tetanized Soul Sand: Rust + soul sand + iron ingot, shapeless.

Tetanized Beacon: normal beacon recipe, substituting a Tetanized Wither Star.

guide.tetanusmod.prevention.body:
Vaccine: %s%% lower Tetanus risk for %s. Drink a Tetanus Vaccine to gain Tetanus Resistance. It does not cure an existing infection or prevent Salmonella. Milk removes this beneficial protection.

Gloves: equip Protective Gloves in the offhand for %s%% lower rusty-contact risk. One durability per exposure; 192 durability. Main-hand or inventory gloves offer no protection. Gloves do not protect against infected food or disease potions.

Together: %s%% lower contact risk. Neither prevents ordinary weapon damage.

Vaccine recipe: Antitoxin + golden apple + glowstone dust + honey bottle, shapeless. Both bottles return.

Gloves recipe: leather in top corners; iron nugget, copper ingot, iron nugget across middle; string below center.

guide.tetanusmod.brewing.body:
Use a glass bottle on a cow to collect Cow Manure. One-minute collection cooldown per cow.

Water Bottle + Cow Manure = Cow Manure Potion.
Cow Manure Potion + Rust = Tetanus.
Cow Manure Potion + Infected Meat = Salmonella.
Add gunpowder for splash versions. Dragon breath makes lingering versions.

Use a normal brewing stand with blaze powder. One ingredient handles up to three bottles.

Tetanus bottles use the duration range shown in Diseases. Salmonella uses normal splash-distance scaling. Potion tooltips describe the actual symptoms.

guide.tetanusmod.commands.body:
Operator permission level 2:
/rustandruin summon minecraft:spider ~ ~ ~
/rustandruin tetanize @e[type=minecraft:zombie,distance=..10]

Commands bypass natural mutation chances and do not target players.

Sounds:
/playsound tetanusmod:tetanus_effect master @a
/playsound tetanusmod:spasm master @a
/playsound tetanusmod:vomit master @a

Both client and server need Rust & Ruin and Fabric API. No recipe viewer is required.

Configure the server in config/tetanusmod.json while stopped. Existing customized values are preserved.
guide.tetanusmod.overview.body:
Rust changes what iron can do. Build tools, let them weather, then choose whether to clean them or use the infection.

This guide is read-only and never consumed. Choose a chapter on the left. Use the mouse wheel or arrow buttons to scroll.

The server controls duration and protection chances. Diseases, Prevention and Creatures show its current settings. Weapon statistics and ritual examples use defaults.

JEI and REI are optional. All recipes also work without a viewer.

guide.tetanusmod.bosses.body:
Build the normal Wither T using four Tetanized Soul Sand blocks for a 5 percent mutation chance. Replace the upper center block with netherite for 30 percent by default. All blocks are consumed; a failed roll summons an ordinary Wither.

A Tetanized Wither has 600 health, a special boss bar, its normal star, a Tetanized Wither Star, Tetanus I and bonus loot. Defeating it awards Tetanus. Nice One!

Brush the special star into an ordinary star, or use it in the normal beacon recipe.

The Tetanized Beacon accepts gold, full copper (including waxed/oxidized) and netherite base blocks. Payments must be netherite ingots.

Primary powers start at II; a complete pyramid offers Regeneration II or a primary upgrade to III. Clear sky access and normal beacon cycling still apply.
message.tetanusmod.manure_wait: This cow needs time. Try again in a minute.
guide.tetanusmod.creatures.body:
Rusty attacks can permanently mutate animals (%s%%) or other ordinary mobs (%s%%). Prevention can stop an exposure before it rolls mutation. Withers use a separate ritual.

Temporary Tetanus is an illness; permanent mutation also changes the skin and attributes. All vanilla mob types support mutation, including spiders, fish and villagers.

Animals become slower. Any infected animal, temporary or permanent, drops only 1-3 infected meat.

Hostile variants gain health and damage where supported, retaining normal drops plus modest salvage.

Use Rust on an iron golem: 18%% chance, 200 maximum health on success. Survival attempts consume one Rust.

Permanent mutation survives saves and ordinary mob conversions. Antitoxin does not remove permanent mutation.

guide.tetanusmod.weapons.body:
4 Nails: two vertical iron ingots, flint to the right of the upper ingot. One heart per ordinary throw; entity hits consume the nail.

Rebar: iron top left, chain center, iron bottom right. Half a heart on a fully charged ordinary unarmored hit.

Sharpened Rebar: flint upper right, rebar lower left, amethyst shard lower right.

Bent Nail: nail + andesite, shapeless.

Metal Pipe: iron, copper, iron across a row.

4 Caltrops: four nails + iron nugget, shapeless. Place as a trap.

Tetanized Arrow: rotten flesh, rusted nail, arrow across one row. Normal bow/crossbow ammunition; Infinity still consumes it. Tetanus I works on melee weapons.
